o1: Involved in defense response to Gram-positive bacterium and vulval development, including vulval fate specification. Acts upstream of or within with a positive effect on cell fate specification. Is part of Ras protein signal transduction. Is located in cytoplasm and nucleus. Is expressed in P3.p hermaphrodite; P4.p hermaphrodite; P5.p hermaphrodite; hermaphrodite distal tip cell; and vulval cell.
